title: Status-line parse now runs before the head-size charge, changing the INVALID_RESPONSE cause for an over-bound malformed status line
description: Pre-refactor order was `String statusLine = lines.read(remaining); remaining = charge(remaining, lines); int status = status(statusLine);`. The refactor inlines the parse into `StatusLine statusLine = statusLine(lines.read(remaining));` and charges afterwards, so parse and bound check swap. When a status line is both malformed and pushes the head past MAX_HEAD_BYTES (e.g. 65536 non-HTTP bytes + CRLF as the first line, or an over-bound malformed status line after a 1xx head), the ProxyException cause (visible to onError/error handlers via getCause()) changes from 'the status line and headers exceed 65536 bytes' to 'malformed status line'. Kind (INVALID_RESPONSE) and the 502 are unchanged, so SEC-PROXY-004 AC-1/AC-2 still hold; impact is diagnostic-only, but it contradicts the commit's behaviour-identical claim.
suggested_fix: Restore the original order: `String line = lines.read(remaining); remaining = charge(remaining, lines); StatusLine statusLine = statusLine(line);` (add a regression test pinning the bound cause for an over-bound malformed status line).
